method: Latency uses Object medians; phase and invocation CPU statistics use eligible input observations with coverage n. Cold has one observation per Object; warm latency reduces two repeats per Object before aggregation. Cold first turn uses exact initial history. Provider-arrival minus driver-start is a cross-Worker clock interval. I/O-clock gaps are observations, not additive CPU/wait spans. Invocation CPU can overlap and is not summed across kinds.

primaryRuns.zeroHistoryPrimary: Use same-run RPC bare/empty Yielded/pi cohorts from coldLong and freshLong, predeclared before collection. Keep original fetch controls separate.

receiptOverlapExamples.selection: Descriptive examples selected after observing the data: three smallest and three largest admission latencies. All fifteen inputs remain in the aggregate. Frozen I/O timestamps are not real-time dispatch wall timestamps.

receiptOverlapSelection: Retrospective three earliest and three latest 1,000-turn cold-Object receipts. No exclusions or causal effect estimate.
